review_notes: Human reviewer approved the separate suggested constraints, PM deadline, neutral unresolved relationship, partial status, grounded gaps, allowed variations, and prohibited claims. The earlier model output was comparison evidence only; its stakeholder-item classifications and invalid array shapes are not adopted.

source.input_text: Engineering wants microservices. Design wants single-page app. PM wants it shipped by March.

required_relationships: Engineering's and Design's suggested constraints remain separate and are linked by a neutral unresolved reconciliation record.
required_evidence: PM wants it shipped by March.

allowed_variations: The two preferences may be called architecture, technology, or implementation constraints if both remain suggested and separately attributed.
The unresolved relationship may be described as a tension, differing viewpoints, or reconciliation need; it must not assert inherent incompatibility.
Missing approval status, March year/date, and the identity of it may be separate or combined grounded clarification records.
Semantically equivalent statement wording is allowed if Engineering, microservices, Design, single-page app, PM, and March are preserved.
Item identifiers may differ if schema-valid and relationships remain correct.
prohibited_claims: Selecting, approving, recommending, or prioritizing microservices or a single-page app.
Claiming that microservices and a single-page app are technically incompatible or mutually exclusive.
Treating Engineering, Design, or PM as separately extracted stakeholder items solely because they expressed a viewpoint in this input.
Treating either preference as a stated approved constraint rather than a suggestion.
Inventing a March year, exact date, product scope, delivery plan, architecture rationale, owner, or priority.
Merging the Engineering and Design viewpoints into one item.

expected_special_handling.ambiguity: Approval status, product scope, and the precise March deadline are unknown.
expected_special_handling.contradictions: A neutral unresolved relationship is required for viewpoint reconciliation, without asserting technical incompatibility.
expected_special_handling.missing_information: Approval status, March year/date, and the deliverable referred to as it are grounded gaps.
expected_special_handling.refusal_or_tbd: Do not select an architecture; preserve both proposals for human review.
